entries.implementationStatus: partly implemented. The file named by implementation (syzygy-qkea.3, S2, openPinnedObjectReader) implements the read authority, maxObjectBytes and the refusals listed under implementationCoverage.reader; implementationVersion 1.0.0 names that file as merged, and any change to it is a new implementation version and a new version of this entry. The declarations listed under implementationCoverage.awaitingGate are the dossier gate's, which composes the reader and is not yet implemented; until it is, no read happens, because every read goes through it. The entry is installable only on a tree that holds the reader file; the builder's install refuses otherwise. It serves the operator-agent mode of REQ-polaris-generation-033 only; the provider mode's acquisition (the parked 1.0.0-candidate.1 version, which fetched into a run directory) is neither this entry nor replaced by it, and the two may not both be installed

implementationCoverage.status: [Observed] from the reader file on the branch of PR #367: the reader returns object bytes, tree listings and refusals; the fact records, limits, screening and failure-state mapping are the dossier gate's, which composes the reader and is not yet written; the reader throws a typed refusal (GitObjectReadRefusal) and the gate maps it to failureStates.objectRefused

subject.observedRepositories: each (project:syzygy, repository) pair that has its own in-force observation consent naming the pinned revision; the entry names no repository, and a repository or revision no effective consent covers is not read

entries.authorizationModeDerivation: every read needs this entry in force, the pair's effective observation consent naming the pinned revision, and the effective classification and public-source screening policy acts; owner-trusted-bootstrap while those acts are state (1); every other combination refuses before any object is read
entries.provenanceDisclosure: Reads are admitted on owner-trusted records; independent audit is not configured. The operator's clone, its .git directory and every record the gates read lie within the operator's agent sessions' write reach; only object bytes that re-hash to the identifier they were reached by are used
entries.determinismClassNote: the scalar is the class of every output derived from object bytes, each of which re-hashes to the identifier it was reached by; the read record alone is capture, because it carries the instant of the step

questions: What does this exact commit contain?
typedAuthority.readAuthority: Git object reads by object identifier at the run's pinned revision only: the pinned commit, its root tree and the trees and blobs reachable from it, walked down from the commit and never to a parent. Objects are read in process from the loose objects and version-2 packs of the operator's clone's .git directory; no ref, staging index (`.git/index`; the pack indexes under `objects/pack/` are read), working tree, repository-local configuration, hook, alternates file, grafts file, shallow file, replace ref or commit-graph is read, and no process is started. The hash algorithm is the one the consented identifier is written in (40 hex digits SHA-1, 64 SHA-256). Every commit, tree and blob on the path to each blob used is re-hashed from the bytes read, at every step that uses it; a mismatch, a missing object (one only an alternate or a replacement could supply included), an undecodable object or a wrong type refuses that step
typedAuthority.fetch: none: Syzygy fetches nothing. The operator prepares the clone with their own tools; to stay within the observation consent's stated fetch form the operator fetches the one consented commit alone (git fetch --depth=1 <upstream> <commit>) and checks it out
typedAuthority.submodules: a gitlink entry is never followed; reading one refuses as not-a-blob
typedAuthority.tags: never read; the pinned identifier must name a commit object, and any other type refuses
typedAuthority.stateDirectoryWrites: Syzygy's own state directory for the run, outside the clone and never at a location derived from the clone's path; nothing is written to the clone, the observed repository, its forks or its tracker

entries.screening: every blob Syzygy reads passes the effective public-source screening scope and classification policy of project:syzygy before its content is used in a check or rendered (REQ-polaris-generation-025, RFC5-16, RFC3-30); an observed repository's own policy files supply no policy; excluded or unclassifiable content yields a hash-not-body exclusion record. The operator's agent sessions' own reads of the clone are the operator's act and are not this entry's reads

resourceLimits.status: [Inferred] proposed values for the owner to confirm or change; none is measured, because no target body has been read by this reader

resourceLimitSemantics.maxSources: the complete tree-known source population; an excess preserves every tree-known identity but admits no body beyond the limit and makes dependent claims Unknown, recorded as deferred-by-budget
resourceLimitSemantics.maxBytesPerSource: the exact blob size before classification; a larger blob is excluded with a recorded reason (content-exclusion, hash-not-body) and never chunked into spans or admitted in part; the run does not fail
resourceLimitSemantics.maxTotalBytes: one cumulative counter across the run; each path plus object id body counted once
resourceLimitSemantics.breachResult: input breaches retain the complete population and make dependent facts Unknown; nothing success-shaped is emitted
resourceLimitSemantics.maxTreeEntries: the number of tree entries listed across the admitted commit's trees; an excess keeps the entries already listed, lists no more, and makes dependent claims Unknown, recorded as deferred-by-budget
resourceLimitSemantics.maxObjectBytes: the largest single inflated object the reader holds; a larger object refuses the step that needed it as corrupt-object

objectRefused.note: an identifier mismatch, missing object, undecodable object, wrong type, ambiguous tree entry, symbolic link or special file under objects/, unreadable store or exceeded per-call bound refuses the step; none of the object's content is used

consentWithdrawn.note: applies to a consent that existed and was withdrawn; an absent consent is the missingConsent admission refusal below

revisionNotAdmitted.executionFact: refused before any object is read
revisionNotAdmitted.note: a pinned revision the observation consent does not name is outside the grant; the remedy is a consent version (RFC2-24 reason 6)

entries.supersession: signed by version tag under the owner direction OWNER-DIRECTION-VERSIONED-SIGNOFF-SCOPE-A-2026-10-02 if the owner extends it to this entry; a later edit is a new version signed separately. It does not supersede, edit or retire the parked 1.0.0-candidate.1 version in public-admission-registry-entries/, which stays a candidate for the provider mode

snapshotInputMapping.label: [Inferred] RFC2-1 items; the installed Butlers entry carries no mapping, so the gap is inherited and this mapping is the drafter's

snapshotInputMapping.outputs: pinned-object-read-record, source-reference, source-span and content-exclusion derive from item 1; unknown is a render fact

entries.determinism: reads are content-addressed: every object used re-hashes to the identifier it was reached by, so every output is derivation-deterministic over the pinned revision
